title: Not “safe” — just honest: MCP quality labels for the long tail
excerpt: 11,500 servers. ~400 with tools. We shipped Ready surface / Auth required / Thin listing filters — facts, not a SAFE badge.
contentHtml:
Not “safe.” Just honest. Influzer’s directory is ~11,500 MCP servers; only ~400 have indexed tools. Stars and docs URLs still make empty listings look finished.

We shipped a live quality layer: surface (Ready / Thin / Unverified), live handshake, auth gate, and tools source — filterable on /mcp, visible on every detail page, and returned by Discovery. No SAFE chip. A 401 on tools/list is a heartbeat; zero tools is a Thin listing.

Full walkthrough: Not safe — just honest.
